text: You already have immutable logs. CloudTrail integrity validation. Object Lock. But that only proves the record wasn't touched. Not that it's complete.
EPI records the application layer. The prompt, the answer, the tool call, the policy decision. Hash chained, redacted, signed into one file.
It answers three questions. Were the bytes altered. Is the signing key yours. Did the run follow policy. Change one byte, and the seal fails closed.
The file is HTML and a ZIP. Open it in a browser, no account, no AWS console. Or witness only the hash, and keep the payload in your bucket.
Don't argue with auditors. Hand them a file. Your immutable logs can stay where they are. Open source. M I T.
